note: Rule catalog, pattern DSL and report labels for review-fact-check. Deterministic rules only; contains no case-specific answers.

citation.number_out_of_range.zh: 正文引用编号 [{k}] 在参考文献表中不存在（表内共 {n} 条）
citation.number_out_of_range.fix_zh: 改为正确的条目编号，或补入该文献完整条目；不得保留悬空编号
citation.number_out_of_range.en: In-text citation [{k}] has no matching entry ({n} entries in the reference list)
citation.number_out_of_range.fix_en: Point to the correct entry or add the missing reference; a dangling number must not remain

citation.uncited_reference.zh: 参考文献条目 {k} 未在正文中被引用
citation.uncited_reference.fix_zh: 补引或删除该条目；若为编号错位，需整体重排并逐条核对全文引用序列
citation.uncited_reference.en: Reference entry {k} is never cited in the text
citation.uncited_reference.fix_en: Cite it or delete it; if numbering is shifted, renumber and re-check every in-text citation

citation.entry_missing.zh: 文中引用作者“{a}”在参考文献表中无对应条目
citation.entry_missing.fix_zh: 补入完整条目（作者、年份、标题、期刊/出处、DOI）或删除该处引用
citation.entry_missing.en: Citation to "{a}" has no matching reference-list entry
citation.entry_missing.fix_en: Add the full entry (authors, year, title, venue, DOI) or delete the citation

citation.year_mismatch.zh: 文中引用的年份 {y} 与条目年份 {ry} 不一致
citation.year_mismatch.fix_zh: 校正年份；若确为同作者不同年份文献，补充 a/b 年份后缀以便区分
citation.year_mismatch.en: In-text year {y} conflicts with reference-list year {ry}
citation.year_mismatch.fix_en: Correct the year; if two papers by the same author exist, add a/b suffixes

citation.duplicate_doi.zh: 同一 DOI {doi} 在参考文献表中出现 {n} 次
citation.duplicate_doi.fix_zh: 合并重复条目，并确认是否把同一文献误作两项证据
citation.duplicate_doi.en: DOI {doi} appears {n} times in the reference list
citation.duplicate_doi.fix_en: Merge duplicates and check whether one source was counted as two

citation.retracted_or_corrected.zh: 被引条目含撤稿/关注声明/更正字样，引用支持力存疑：{q}
citation.retracted_or_corrected.fix_zh: 核验该文献当前出版状态与版本（出版方页面、撤稿数据库），必要时更换证据或在正文说明状态
citation.retracted_or_corrected.en: Cited entry carries a retraction / expression-of-concern / correction marker: {q}
citation.retracted_or_corrected.fix_en: Verify current publication status and version; replace the evidence or state the status in text

citation.preprint_status.zh: 所引文献为预印本或未经同行评议的版本：{q}
citation.preprint_status.fix_zh: 核验是否已有正式发表版本并改引正式版；只能引预印本时，正文须标注“preprint”并说明证据等级
citation.preprint_status.en: Cited work is a preprint / non-peer-reviewed version: {q}
citation.preprint_status.fix_en: Check for a peer-reviewed version and cite it; if only the preprint exists, label it in text

citation.review_supports_causal.zh: 以综述/荟萃分析 {q} 支撑因果性断言
citation.review_supports_causal.fix_zh: 改引提供直接因果证据的原始研究，或把断言降级为相关性/综述层面的概括
citation.review_supports_causal.en: A review/meta-analysis {q} is used to support a causal claim
citation.review_supports_causal.fix_en: Cite primary causal evidence, or downgrade the claim to an associational statement

citation.uncited_assertion.zh: 陈述他人结论或既有事实但未给出来源：{q}
citation.uncited_assertion.fix_zh: 补具体文献（作者+年份或编号）；无来源的事实性表述应删除或改写为本文观察
citation.uncited_assertion.en: Prior work or an established fact is asserted without a source: {q}
citation.uncited_assertion.fix_en: Add a specific citation, or rewrite as this study's own observation

stats.p_zero.zh: p 值写作 {q}：精确概率不可能为 0
stats.p_zero.fix_zh: 改为 p < 0.001（或所用软件的最小精度），并同时给出检验统计量与自由度
stats.p_zero.en: p-value reported as {q}; an exact probability cannot be zero
stats.p_zero.fix_en: Report p < 0.001 (or the software's floor) together with the test statistic and df

stats.claim_without_test.zh: 声称“显著”但同句未给出检验统计量或 p 值：{q}
stats.claim_without_test.fix_zh: 补检验方法、统计量、自由度与 p 值；或改写为描述性表述
stats.claim_without_test.en: Significance is claimed without a test statistic or p-value in the same sentence: {q}
stats.claim_without_test.fix_en: Add test, statistic, df and p; or rewrite descriptively

stats.no_effect_size.zh: 全文报告 p 值但未见效应量与置信区间，效应大小与精度无法判断
stats.no_effect_size.fix_zh: 补效应量（OR/HR/β/Cohen's d 等）与 95% CI，避免只依赖显著性
stats.no_effect_size.en: p-values are reported but no effect size or confidence interval appears
stats.no_effect_size.fix_en: Add effect sizes (OR/HR/beta/d) with 95% CI; do not rely on significance alone

stats.no_power_analysis.zh: 未见样本量估算或检验效能说明，统计结论的稳健性无法判断
stats.no_power_analysis.fix_zh: 在方法中补样本量依据（效应量假设、α、power）或声明该分析为探索性
stats.no_power_analysis.en: No sample-size justification or power statement is given
stats.no_power_analysis.fix_en: Add sample-size rationale (effect size, alpha, power) or declare the analysis exploratory

stats.unnamed_dispersion.zh: 使用 ± 表示离散度但未说明是 SD 还是 SEM：{q}
stats.unnamed_dispersion.fix_zh: 在方法或图注中明确 SD/SEM 并统一全文写法
stats.unnamed_dispersion.en: Dispersion is shown with a plus-minus sign but SD vs SEM is never defined: {q}
stats.unnamed_dispersion.fix_en: Define SD or SEM in Methods or caption and keep it consistent

stats.trend_misuse.zh: 以“趋势/边缘显著”表述未达阈值的比较：{q}
stats.trend_misuse.fix_zh: 如实报告 p 值与效应区间，不用趋势性措辞替代预设检验
stats.trend_misuse.en: A non-significant comparison is described as a trend: {q}
stats.trend_misuse.fix_en: Report the actual p-value and interval instead of trend wording

stats.boundary_p.zh: p 值落在 0.05 判定边界上，结论对阈值口径敏感：{q}
stats.boundary_p.fix_zh: 同时报告精确 p 值、单双侧与预设 α，并说明边界值的处理方式
stats.boundary_p.en: p sits exactly on the 0.05 decision boundary, so the verdict depends on the convention: {q}
stats.boundary_p.fix_en: Report the exact p, one/two-sided choice and pre-specified alpha

stats.missing_n.zh: 报告均值±离散度但未给出样本量，比较的分母不明：{q}
stats.missing_n.fix_zh: 在句中或图注补各组 n；缺失时不得比较组间差异
stats.missing_n.en: Mean and dispersion are reported without the sample size: {q}
stats.missing_n.fix_en: Give n per group in text or caption

method.randomization_undescribed.zh: 声称随机化但未描述随机序列生成与分配隐藏：{q}
method.randomization_undescribed.fix_zh: 补随机化方法（序列生成、分配隐藏、分层因素）；非随机设计请删除该措辞
method.randomization_undescribed.en: Randomization is claimed but sequence generation and allocation concealment are not described: {q}
method.randomization_undescribed.fix_en: Describe sequence generation, allocation concealment and stratification, or drop the wording

method.no_control.zh: 存在组间比较结论，但方法部分未见对照/比较组描述：{q}
method.no_control.fix_zh: 补对照组的设置、来源与处理方式；无对照时不得给出比较性结论
method.no_control.en: Between-group claims appear, but no control/comparator is described in Methods: {q}
method.no_control.fix_en: Describe the comparator; without one, comparative conclusions are not supported

method.extrapolation.zh: 证据以体外/细胞水平为主，结论却外推到临床：{q}
method.extrapolation.fix_zh: 把结论限定在体外/细胞水平，或补充体内与临床验证并说明外推限度
method.extrapolation.en: Evidence is in vitro/cell-level while the conclusion extends to patients: {q}
method.extrapolation.fix_en: Restrict the conclusion or add in vivo/clinical validation and state the limits of extrapolation

method.no_criteria.zh: 研究对象纳入/排除标准缺失，样本代表性无法评估：{q}
method.no_criteria.fix_zh: 补纳入/排除标准、招募方式与时间范围
method.no_criteria.en: Inclusion/exclusion criteria for the study objects are missing: {q}
method.no_criteria.fix_en: Add eligibility criteria, recruitment route and period

argument.causal_overreach.zh: 相关性或观察性证据被表述为因果结论：{q}
argument.causal_overreach.fix_zh: 改为关联性表述（associated with / may contribute），并说明混杂控制与替代解释
argument.causal_overreach.en: Correlational or observational evidence is stated as a causal conclusion: {q}
argument.causal_overreach.fix_en: Use associational wording and address confounding and alternative explanations

argument.review_as_evidence.zh: 以综述性表述支撑确定性断言：{q}
argument.review_as_evidence.fix_zh: 改引原始研究，或把断言降级为综述层面的概括
argument.review_as_evidence.en: A review-level statement carries a definitive assertion: {q}
argument.review_as_evidence.fix_en: Cite primary studies or soften the assertion

argument.novelty_claim.zh: 首次性/新颖性断言缺少检索证据：{q}
argument.novelty_claim.fix_zh: 补检索策略、数据库与时间范围作为依据，或弱化为“据我们所知”
argument.novelty_claim.en: A first-ever/novelty claim lacks a documented literature search: {q}
argument.novelty_claim.fix_en: Document the search strategy and dates, or soften to 'to our knowledge'

argument.absolute_wording.zh: 结论使用绝对化措辞，与单研究证据强度不匹配：{q}
argument.absolute_wording.fix_zh: 限定范围与条件（在何种样本、剂量、时程下成立）
argument.absolute_wording.en: The conclusion uses absolute wording that a single study cannot support: {q}
argument.absolute_wording.fix_en: Bound the claim by sample, dose, duration and conditions

norm.missing_section.zh: 缺少可识别的“{a}”章节标题，结构不完整
norm.missing_section.fix_zh: 补该章节；若输入为节选，需在报告与结果状态中说明审查范围
norm.missing_section.en: A "{a}" section cannot be identified; the structure is incomplete
norm.missing_section.fix_en: Add the section, or state in the report that only an excerpt was reviewed

norm.no_ethics_statement.zh: 涉及人体或动物研究对象，但未见伦理审批与知情同意声明：{q}
norm.no_ethics_statement.fix_zh: 补伦理委员会名称、批准号与知情同意说明；确无伦理要求的，写明依据
norm.no_ethics_statement.en: Human or animal subjects are involved but no ethics approval/consent statement appears: {q}
norm.no_ethics_statement.fix_en: Add committee name, approval number and consent statement, or justify the exemption

norm.no_coi.fix_zh: 补利益冲突声明；无冲突时明确写“无利益冲突”
norm.no_coi.fix_en: Add one; state 'none declared' when applicable

norm.no_data_availability.zh: 缺少数据与代码可用性声明
norm.no_data_availability.fix_zh: 补数据/代码可用性声明（仓库链接、登记号或获取条件）
norm.no_data_availability.fix_en: Add availability details (repository, accession, or access conditions)

norm.no_funding.fix_zh: 补资助来源与项目编号；无资助时注明“无”
norm.no_funding.fix_en: Add funder and grant number, or state 'none'

norm.no_author_contrib.fix_zh: 补作者贡献（构思、实验、分析、写作）与通讯作者信息
norm.no_author_contrib.fix_en: Add contribution roles and corresponding author

norm.no_reporting_guideline.zh: 属需要规范报告的研究类型，但未声明遵循的报告指南：{q}
norm.no_reporting_guideline.fix_zh: 声明遵循 CONSORT/PRISMA/STROBE/ARRIVE 等清单并附检查表
norm.no_reporting_guideline.en: This study type requires a reporting guideline, but none is declared: {q}
norm.no_reporting_guideline.fix_en: Declare the applicable guideline and attach the checklist

norm.supplement_missing.zh: 正文引用补充材料，但输入中未见补充文件：{q}
norm.supplement_missing.fix_zh: 提供补充材料，或在报告中说明未随稿提交、相关结论暂不可核
norm.supplement_missing.en: Supplementary material is cited but no supplementary file was supplied: {q}
norm.supplement_missing.fix_en: Provide the supplement or record that the related claims stay unverified

norm.few_references.zh: 参考文献仅 {n} 条，证据基础偏薄
norm.few_references.fix_zh: 补关键原始研究，尤其是方法与对照依据的来源
norm.few_references.en: Only {n} references; the evidence base is thin
norm.few_references.fix_en: Add key primary studies, especially for methods and comparators

norm.self_citation.zh: 疑似自引比例较高（{n}/{m} 条条目含 we/our 表述）
norm.self_citation.fix_zh: 核对自引必要性，补充独立来源证据
norm.self_citation.fix_en: Check necessity of self-citations and add independent evidence

norm.duplicate_publication_cue.zh: 出现可能指向重复发表或拆分发表的表述：{q}
norm.duplicate_publication_cue.fix_zh: 核对该文与既有发表的关系，必要时说明数据重叠与引用关系
norm.duplicate_publication_cue.en: Wording suggesting duplicate or salami publication: {q}
norm.duplicate_publication_cue.fix_en: Clarify relationship to prior publications and data overlap

fact.percent_fraction_mismatch.zh: 百分比与分数不一致：{pct}% 与 {a}/{b}（应为 {real}%）
fact.percent_fraction_mismatch.fix_zh: 按 {a}/{b} 重算百分比，并同步正文、表格与图注三处
fact.percent_fraction_mismatch.fix_en: Recompute from {a}/{b} and propagate to text, table and caption

fact.sample_size_mismatch.zh: 摘要样本量 {a} 与正文 {b} 无交集，可能不一致
fact.sample_size_mismatch.fix_zh: 核对真实样本量，统一摘要、方法与表 1 中的 N
fact.sample_size_mismatch.en: Abstract sample size {a} and body {b} do not overlap
fact.sample_size_mismatch.fix_en: Confirm the true N and make abstract, methods and Table 1 agree

fact.abstract_number_absent.zh: 摘要中的数字在正文找不到对应表述：{q}
fact.abstract_number_absent.fix_zh: 核对该数字的来源，补正文与表格中的支撑，或修正摘要
fact.abstract_number_absent.en: A number in the abstract has no counterpart in the body: {q}
fact.abstract_number_absent.fix_en: Trace the number to the body/table or correct the abstract

patterns.regex: (?i)(?:studies have shown|previous (?:studies|work|research)|it is (?:well )?known|has been reported|reported that|研究表明|已有研究)[^.\n]{0,150}

patterns.absent_doc: (?i)(sample size|power analys|power calculation|功效|检验效能)

patterns.regex: (?i)(trend (?:toward|towards)|borderline significan|marginally significan|接近显著|边缘显著)[^.\n]{0,80}
(?i)\b(?:prove[sdn]?|proven|demonstrates? that|establishes? that|causes?|causal(?:ly)?|confirms? that|证实|证明|导致)\b[^.\n]{0,90}
(?i)\b(first (?:time|report|demonstration)|unprecedented|for the first time|首次|前所未有)\b[^.\n]{0,90}

patterns.require_doc: (?i)(patients?|participants?|volunteers?|human subjects?|informed consent|患者|受试者|志愿者|\bmice\b|\brats?\b|小鼠|大鼠)
patterns.absent_doc: (?i)(ethic|irb|institutional review board|approval (?:number|no)|declaration of helsinki|伦理|批准号)
(?i)(conflict of interest|competing interest|利益冲突|声明无冲突)
(?i)(data availability|data and code|available (?:from|on) (?:reasonable )?request|数据可用|数据获取)

zh.title: 审查报告：引用与事实核验
zh.sum_line: 文档 {n} 份、可读字符 {c}；问题 {t} 条（阻断 {M} / 建议 {m} / 提示 {i}），待人工复核 {p} 条。
zh.s_matrix: 4. 引用支持矩阵（语义判定留空）
zh.matrix_note: 共 {n} 组“句子→引用”配对。verdict 取 full/partial/none/undetermined，须对照被引文献原文判定；本表不预设结论，未判定的进入待复核。
zh.statement: 本报告由 Skill 在当前输入上实际运行生成，不含预制答案。未联网检索，被引文献自身的结论未在本平台核验，涉及外部文献内容的判断一律进入待复核。
zh.method: 执行两阶段流程：(1) 确定性规则扫描，覆盖引用编号与条目一致性、数值与百分比自洽、统计报告完整性、方法设计、论证链、学术规范六类；(2) 引用支持矩阵，把“结论句→被引条目”逐组列出，判定字段留空并标注所需证据。所有条目均附定位串与逐字原文，可回查。

en.title: Review report: citation & fact verification
en.sum_line: {n} document(s), {c} characters; {t} finding(s) (major {M} / minor {m} / info {i}), {p} pending human review.
en.matrix_note: {n} claim-citation pairs. Verdict in full/partial/none/undetermined must be decided against the cited source; nothing is presupposed, undecided pairs go to pending review.
en.statement: Produced by running the Skill on the supplied input; no prepared answers. No network access was used, so statements about the content of cited works stay pending human review.
en.method: Two passes: (1) deterministic rule scan over citation numbering/entries, numeric and percentage consistency, statistical reporting, method design, argument chain and academic norms; (2) a citation-support matrix pairing each claim sentence with its cited entry, leaving verdicts explicitly open. Every item carries a locator and a verbatim quote.

pattern_dsl.regex: required; searched in the section slice or whole document
pattern_dsl.require_near: regex that MUST match within +/-window of the match
pattern_dsl.not_near: regex that MUST NOT match within +/-window (false-positive control)
pattern_dsl.require_doc: regex that must match somewhere in the document, else the rule is skipped
pattern_dsl.absent_doc: regex that must be absent from the whole document, else the rule is skipped

absent_in_section.regex: skip if this regex matches in that section

pattern_dsl.doc_level: emit once for the document (document-level absence checks)

sections: conflict of interest|competing interest|利益冲突
